calculation_steps: Check positive-stock prepared witnesses and typed cut controls

result.exact_expression: A(x) intersect Fix(Stab(x)) nonempty iff an exclusive equivariant selector exists on the orbit
result.scope: An exclusive equivariant selector exists on a prepared orbit exactly when its eligible contacts include a point fixed by the prepared-state stabilizer. Positive odd stock permits contexts without any fixed contact. The hard-gate product evaluates supplied factor histories and leaves native abort and cut authority open.

counterexamples_and_failures: Positive-stock 2+2 vertex profile can obstruct all eligible face contacts
A product or spatial aggregate of gates can conceal cause or contact identity
One-sided disengagement can recreate donor amplitude and change joint stock
limitations: Native selector or shared-actuator grant, predicate histories and root-veto ordering remain open
next_discriminant: Test whether admitted same-operator contacts can spend one cell-level capability in a symmetric batch without confusing different operators or typed vetoes.
